scope: Read-only review of the ID Term duplicate-owner packet; R2275 retirement is not applied.
approved_decision: Keep the Term registry and Term//ID; M450 preserves the approved meaning; retire only exact CA-R-2275@2 preimage after the Method owner is valid. No new R2275 archive/version/ID/timestamp.

meaning_review.approved_definition: Unique identifier used to find one Continuant or Occurrent entity instance, unique within its matching prefix namespace.
retained_constraints: CA-P-123 / CA-P-123@1-draft / CA-P-123@3 are examples only; no lifecycle identity or version equivalence inferred
distinct complete qualified names atom.id and projection.id

R1319.claim: A Governed Term meaning is owned by exactly one active Method Atom of Type Term Definition.

E659.applicable_check: Requires a well-formed Method Atom of Type Term Definition; explicitly says such Term Definition requires an admitted Type declaration in the Method Type domain.

current_method_type_declaration_search.conclusion: No Current declaration of the Method Type Term Definition was found. CA-R-2468@2 only registers a Requirement Type and E659 explicitly says that does not admit the Method Type.

R2468.meaning: Registers Declaration as a Requirement Form; does not supply the missing Method Type declaration.

owner_review.R1319_current_provenance_note: R1319@28 has a clear active Claim establishing the Method-owner criterion, but retains a stale Draft source-pin block and a closing sentence saying “This Draft”. This supports treating Type admission as a current-source coherence gap, not assuming the Method Type is already admitted.

retirement_and_reference_review.disposition: Do not retire CA-R-2275@2 until a Current admitted Method Type exists and M450 passes the applicable well-formedness check. The exact preimage is ready; no archive surrogate is created.
retirement_and_reference_review.historical_and_frozen_treatment: Keep all archive, generated/staged, draft-analysis, plan, and noncurrent mirror records byte-identical; do not blanket rewrite. Regenerate derived projections only through their existing owners after an authorized retirement.

evidence: CA-E-659@3 explicitly requires an admitted Method Type declaration and says CA-R-2468@2 registers only a Requirement Type.
No Current Method Type Term Definition declaration was found in the scoped native Current Core Model source tree; the matching R2453 source appears only in archives, if present.
CA-R-1319@28 sets Method/Form as the meaning-owner role but does not itself supply the missing Method Type registration.
finding.effect: M450@4 is the sole current Method/Form Term Definition candidate for Term//ID, but Current authority does not establish that it passes E659. Retiring R2275 would remove the only Current Requirement-form ID-definition source while leaving no confirmed valid owner.
finding.smallest_resolution: Admit the Method Type under its authorized source contract, then validate M450@next against E659 before retiring the exact R2275@2 carrier. Do not change the ID meaning or invent a replacement owner in this packet.

limits: No Current source, archive, runtime, code, test, or Git state changed.
